1	export type Cell = [x: number, y: number];
2	
3	const isWithinOneStep = (coordinate: number, otherCoordinate: number): boolean =>
4	  Math.abs(otherCoordinate - coordinate) <= 1;
5	
6	const isSameCell = ([x, y]: Cell, [otherX, otherY]: Cell): boolean =>
7	  x === otherX && y === otherY;
8	
9	const isNeighborOf = (cell: Cell, other: Cell): boolean => {
10	  const [x, y] = cell;
11	  const [otherX, otherY] = other;
12	  return (
13	    isWithinOneStep(x, otherX) &&
14	    isWithinOneStep(y, otherY) &&
15	    !isSameCell(cell, other)
16	  );
17	};
18	
19	const countLivingNeighbors = (cell: Cell, livingCells: Cell[]): number =>
20	  livingCells.filter((other) => isNeighborOf(cell, other)).length;
21	
22	const survives = (livingNeighbors: number): boolean =>
23	  livingNeighbors >= 2 && livingNeighbors <= 3;
24	
25	const neighborsOf = ([x, y]: Cell): Cell[] => [
26	  [x - 1, y - 1],
27	  [x, y - 1],
28	  [x + 1, y - 1],
29	  [x - 1, y],
30	  [x + 1, y],
31	  [x - 1, y + 1],
32	  [x, y + 1],
33	  [x + 1, y + 1],
34	];
35	
36	const isLiving = (cell: Cell, livingCells: Cell[]): boolean =>
37	  livingCells.some((livingCell) => isSameCell(cell, livingCell));
38	
39	const bornCells = (livingCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
40	  livingCells
41	    .flatMap(neighborsOf)
42	    .filter(
43	      (candidate) =>
44	        !isLiving(candidate, livingCells) &&
45	        countLivingNeighbors(candidate, livingCells) === 3,
46	    );
47	
48	export const nextGeneration = (livingCells: Cell[]): Cell[] => [
49	  ...livingCells.filter((cell) =>
50	    survives(countLivingNeighbors(cell, livingCells)),
51	  ),
52	  ...bornCells(livingCells),
53	];
